synthesizedFacts.fact: Eczema is a skin condition characterized by dry, itchy patches and is not contagious.
Atopic dermatitis is the most common form of eczema and often begins in childhood.
Eczema can be triggered by environmental factors such as allergens and irritants.
Eczema is associated with other conditions like hay fever and asthma.
